sn55.51:1.1: Catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ||
sn55.51:2.2: Idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.51:2.3: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.51:2.6: Ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi || la-pe || samādhisaṃvattanikehi || ||
sn55.51:2.7: Imehi kho bhikkhave catuhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano ti || || 4.
